create.name: Dr. Catherine Shainberg
create.bio:
Catherine Shainberg is a psychologist and teacher of a Sephardic Kabbalah tradition that works through dreams and the imagination. She studied for many years in Jerusalem with the kabbalist Colette Aboulker-Muscat, who named her the present lineage holder of what is called the Kabbalah of Light. In 1982 she founded the School of Images in New York, which now has study centres and licensed teachers in several countries.

Her methods are built on very short imagery exercises, a few breaths long, meant to quiet the thinking mind and open a conversation with the subconscious. The best known are Saphire Imagery and DreamOpening, a group process in which a dream is entered and explored rather than analysed. The school also teaches morphology, the reading of body form, and a way of using the tarot as a book of images. Her books include Kabbalah and the Power of Dreaming and The Kabbalah of Light, published by Inner Traditions in 2022. She has taught at Esalen, the Open Center and the Rubin Museum, among many other places, and still lectures in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, with the school's core courses now held mostly online.

books.title: Kabbalah and the Power of Dreaming: Awakening the Visionary Life
books.author: Catherine Shainberg
books.description: Her introduction to the dream tradition she inherited, with many short imagery exercises for working with night dreams and waking images.

books.title: The Kabbalah of Light: Ancient Practices to Ignite the Imagination and Illuminate the Soul
books.author: Catherine Shainberg
books.description: A fuller account of the lineage she received in Jerusalem and its practices, using imagination and visualisation as a path to higher awareness.

courses.title: Saphire Imagery for Self-Development
courses.description: The School of Images' programme for personal study, which can be taken as single workshops, a term-long class or a full course, covering imagery, DreamOpening, morphology and tarot. Completed classes can later count towards certification.
